translated: This is... the port of Solde, isn't it?

From here, just crossing the sea by ship,
Dipan is right there, and yet...

( That's why I came.
Hurry to Dipan! )
Huh!?

( Return home as soon as you can,
and urge the king to prepare for war. )
...Fight?

( To lure us out,
the gods will likely attack Dipan. )
A war... because of us?
( That is the gods' <PART> ---- <PART> )
( Odin's way... )

...There is no way my father would
listen to what I say.

Then I will make the appeal! The king too
surely cannot forgive the gods' tyranny!
( But I don't want to go back to Dipan! )

What are you saying at this point...
What did we leave the castle for!?
( It was to run far away, right? )
Where to?
( Somewhere... far away )
...Too naive!
Ahly will chase us to the ends of the earth.

To kill you and summon my spirit
back to Valhalla...
( Is it because you are... also a valkyrie? )
That's right...

Two valkyries are not permitted to
exist in Midgard at the same time.

Besides, I still have many einherjar
that must be transferred.

Though I am a being of nothing but thoughts
dwelling in your soul, I defy the gods' providence.
Enough already, understand this.
I do understand!

( We need preparations before going
to Dipan. When the time comes, you will
have no choice but to fight. )
Me, fight!?
I've said it many times, but I can't...
( Then let us look for companions. )
...Companions?

( Never mind about it <PART> ---- <PART>
just do as I say for a while. )
( Hurry to the wharf. )

( I will guide you to the Royal Underground
Path from here. )
Royal? You mean Dipan's?

( It is odd that I, an outsider, should
guide you, a member of the royal family. )

( Please head to the forest.
The entrance to the underground path lies deep within it. )
What are you muttering about?
N...nothing.

By the way, you...
you said you are the princess of Dipan?
Then why are you alone in a place like this?
Where have you been until now?

I heard that the only daughter of King
Barbarossa of Dipan died some years ago...

What about you, where have you been,
and what are you going to Dipan for?

I have not yet asked your name,
have I.
...It's Rufus.
A pleasure, Sir Rufus...
